wants.topic: Emotional domestic miracles featuring divine tests by Devis/Devtas (e.g., Maa Durga acting as a servant or taking chores)
wants.evidence: GuruVaani Studio video 'माँ दुर्गा से आखिर क्यों बूढ़ी औरत ने करवाया खूब काम?' achieved vsNormal 264.64 (6.28M views).

wants.topic: Modern saint miracle bio-dramas (Neem Karoli Baba, modern Avtars)
wants.evidence: Anant Gatha's Neem Karoli Baba films generated vsNormal 45.8 and 21.13 across multiple long-form videos.

wants.topic: Addressing common theological questions and doubts about Sanatan Dharma logically
wants.evidence: Bk Usha Motivational video 'हिंदू धर्म में इतने भगवान और दूसरे धर्म में एक ही भगवान क्यों?' hit vsNormal 138.3.

wants.topic: Multi-part serialized AI Kathas involving high-stakes challenges (Swayamvar with impossible conditions)
wants.evidence: THE BH STORIES 'घमंडी राजकुमारी का स्वयंवर' Part 1, 2, and 3 consistently outperformed with vsNormal 34.58, 15.99, and 12.3.

wants.topic: Playful and humorous character-driven Bhakt-Bhagwan interaction stories
wants.evidence: JagaLeela Studio's 'Adhaiya' character series consistently achieved vsNormal 9.13 to 10.63.

gaps: High-quality 4K cinematic storytelling of modern Hindu saints and avatars.
Emotional kathas where deities interact directly with everyday household struggles (poverty, family mistreatment) rather than abstract cosmic battles.
Clear, engaging explanations answering defensive theological questions about Hindu customs and iconography.
saturated: Dry historical documentaries (e.g., Chanakya history, dry temple history without narrative drama).
Generic short-form motivational reels and generic quotes.
Abstract philosophical discourses (e.g., Karma Yoga vs Sanyas Yoga).
Absurd or unrelatable folk tales lacking emotional connection (e.g., marrying animals).
